lines.text: Do you know how an AI actually reads your message?
You type: my cat stole my sandwich. To you, that's a sentence. To the AI, it's a pile of pieces.
First, the words get chopped into tokens. Little chunks, and each chunk becomes a number.
Every number is a spot on a giant map of meaning. Cat lands near dog and kitten. Sandwich lands near lunch.
Then each word looks at every other word, to work out who did what. Stole links cat to sandwich.
And then it guesses. One word at a time, it picks the most likely next piece, again and again, until it has an answer.
So an AI reads whatever you give it. Orbi Transfer is the opposite. Your file is locked on your phone before it leaves, so nobody on the way can read it.
